title: API: SrpgCore.Combat
html:
API: SrpgCore.Combat

Generated from ../SrpgCore sources by scripts/build-api.ts — do not edit by hand.

Guide: combat.

HitMode

Hit-roll models, per-difficulty (default TRUE_HIT).

Name Value Description
Classic 0 Single roll with true odds.
TrueHit 1 Mean of two rolls for GBA feel.
TrueHitPlus 2 Mean of three rolls, tighter around the displayed rate.
Fates 3 Single roll against a Fates-adjusted threshold.

CombatRules

Tunable battle formula constants (GBA FE7/8 defaults).

CombatRules.TriangleMightBonus

Might added per triangle advantage step (GBA default 1).

public int TriangleMightBonus { get; set; }

Type: int

CombatRules.TriangleHitBonus

Hit added per triangle advantage step (GBA default 15).

public int TriangleHitBonus { get; set; }

Type: int

CombatRules.DoubleAttackSpeedThreshold

Attack-speed lead needed to strike twice (GBA default 4).

public int DoubleAttackSpeedThreshold { get; set; }

Type: int

CombatRules.HitMode

Hit-roll model used for strikes (default TrueHit).

public HitMode HitMode { get; set; }

Type: HitMode

CombatRules.EffectiveMultiplier

Damage multiplier for effective weapons (GBA x3).

public int EffectiveMultiplier { get; set; }

Type: int

CombatRules.TorchVisionBonus

Vision bonus granted by the Torch staff status (GBA default 2).

public int TorchVisionBonus { get; set; }

Type: int

CombatForecast

Battle-forecast numbers shown to the player before committing. Values: Damage per landed hit, Hit and Crit rates 0-100, AttackCount (1 or 2 when doubling), TriangleAdvantage (-1/0/1), and IsEffective flag.

CombatForecast.Damage

Predicted damage per landed hit after defense and terrain.

public int Damage { get; set; }

Type: int

CombatForecast.Hit

Predicted hit rate from 0 to 100 after skills and support.

public int Hit { get; set; }

Type: int

CombatForecast.Crit

Predicted crit rate from 0 to 100 after skills.

public int Crit { get; set; }

Type: int

CombatForecast.AttackCount

Number of attacker strikes, 1 normally or 2 when doubling.

public int AttackCount { get; set; }

Type: int

CombatForecast.TriangleAdvantage

Triangle result from the attacker side: 1, 0, or -1.

public int TriangleAdvantage { get; set; }

Type: int

CombatForecast.IsEffective

True when the attacking weapon is effective against the defender class.

public bool IsEffective { get; set; }

Type: bool

CombatStrike

One rolled strike inside a resolved exchange. Values: IsAttackerStrike (true = attacker swing, false = counter), HitLanded, WasCrit (triple damage), and DamageDealt (0 on miss).

CombatStrike.IsAttackerStrike

True for attacker strikes, false for defender counters.

public bool IsAttackerStrike { get; set; }

Type: bool

CombatStrike.HitLanded

True when the hit roll landed.

public bool HitLanded { get; set; }

Type: bool

CombatStrike.WasCrit

True when the landed hit rolled a crit for triple damage.

public bool WasCrit { get; set; }

Type: bool

CombatStrike.DamageDealt

Damage applied by this strike, zero on a miss.

public int DamageDealt { get; set; }

Type: int

CombatResult

Full strike log of a resolved exchange. Values: ordered Strikes list (attacker strikes with counter between them) and AttackerHPLeft/DefenderHPLeft clamped at zero; the same HP is written back to the combatants.

CombatResult.Strikes

Ordered strike log: attacker strikes with the counter between them.

public List<CombatStrike> Strikes { get; }

Type: List<CombatStrike>

CombatResult.AttackerHPLeft

Attacker HP after the exchange, clamped at zero.

public int AttackerHPLeft { get; set; }

Type: int

CombatResult.DefenderHPLeft

Defender HP after the exchange, clamped at zero.

public int DefenderHPLeft { get; set; }

Type: int

CombatResolver

Pure combat math. Forecast() feeds the UI; Resolve() consumes RNG and mutates HP. Same inputs + same seed always give the same result (AI, forecasts, replays share it). Durability is consumed by the InventoryEntry overload of Resolve(); the Weapon overload stays pure for forecasts/tests. Healing/status staves use ForecastHeal, ForecastStaffHit and ResolveStaff (1RN); flat skill mods via SkillCatalog. Post-strike unit actions live in Tactics: Dance (adjacent refresh, host-tracked acted flags) and Canto (leftover-move repositioning).

CombatResolver.AttackSpeed

Attack speed: Speed minus encumbrance from excess weapon weight.

public static int AttackSpeed(Unit unit, Weapon weapon)
Parameter Type Description
unit Unit The unit whose Speed and Constitution apply.
weapon Weapon The weapon whose Weight may slow the unit.

Returns: int — Effective attack speed used for hit and doubling.

CombatResolver.TerrainAt

Terrain avoid/defense at a tile (single lookup for callers).

public static void TerrainAt(Grid.Board board, Grid.GridPoint pos, out int avoid, out int defense)
Parameter Type Description
board Grid.Board The board holding the terrain table.
pos Grid.GridPoint The tile to look up.
avoid out int The terrain avoid at the tile.
defense out int The terrain defense at the tile.

CombatResolver.ComputeDamage

Damage per landed hit: attack stat plus might and triangle, minus defense and terrain.

public static int ComputeDamage(Unit attacker, Weapon attackWeapon, Unit defender, int defenderTerrainDefense, int triangle, bool effective, CombatRules? rules = null)
Parameter Type Description
attacker Unit The attacking unit supplying the attack stat.
attackWeapon Weapon The attacking weapon supplying might and magic selection.
defender Unit The defending unit supplying defense or resistance and class key.
defenderTerrainDefense int Defense from the defender tile subtracted from damage.
triangle int Triangle advantage from the attacker side.
effective bool True when the weapon is effective against the defender class.
rules CombatRules? Formula tunables, or null for GBA defaults.

Returns: int — Clamped damage per landed hit.

CombatResolver.ComputeHitRate

Hit rate: weapon hit plus skill and luck and triangle, minus defender avoid.

public static int ComputeHitRate(Unit attacker, Weapon attackWeapon, Unit defender, Weapon? defendWeapon, int defenderTerrainAvoid, CombatRules? rules = null)
Parameter Type Description
attacker Unit The attacking unit supplying skill and luck.
attackWeapon Weapon The attacking weapon supplying base hit.
defender Unit The defending unit supplying avoid inputs.
defendWeapon Weapon? The defending weapon for triangle and counter AS, or null when disarmed.
defenderTerrainAvoid int Avoid from the defender tile added to defender avoid.
rules CombatRules? Formula tunables, or null for GBA defaults.

Returns: int — Clamped hit rate from 0 to 100.

CombatResolver.ComputeAvoidRate

Avoid total: attack speed plus terrain avoid plus half luck.

public static int ComputeAvoidRate(Unit defender, Weapon? defendWeapon, Weapon incomingWeapon, int defenderTerrainAvoid)
Parameter Type Description
defender Unit The defending unit supplying speed and luck.
defendWeapon Weapon? The defending weapon for attack speed, or null to use the incoming weapon.
incomingWeapon Weapon The incoming weapon used for attack speed when disarmed.
defenderTerrainAvoid int Avoid from the defender tile.

Returns: int — Unclamped avoid total.

CombatResolver.ComputeCritRate

Crit rate: half skill plus weapon crit minus defender luck.

public static int ComputeCritRate(Unit attacker, Weapon attackWeapon, Unit defender)
Parameter Type Description
attacker Unit The attacking unit supplying skill.
attackWeapon Weapon The attacking weapon supplying base crit.
defender Unit The defending unit supplying luck.

Returns: int — Clamped crit rate from 0 to 100.

CombatResolver.ComputeAttackCount

Strike count: 2 when the attacker doubles, else 1.

public static int ComputeAttackCount(Unit attacker, Weapon attackWeapon, Unit defender, Weapon? defendWeapon, CombatRules? rules = null)
Parameter Type Description
attacker Unit The attacking unit supplying attack speed.
attackWeapon Weapon The attacking weapon supplying weight.
defender Unit The defending unit supplying attack speed.
defendWeapon Weapon? The defending weapon for speed, or null when disarmed.
rules CombatRules? Formula tunables, or null for GBA defaults.

Returns: int — Number of attacker strikes, 1 or 2.

CombatResolver.Forecast

Pure GBA-style forecast: damage, hit, crit, strikes, triangle, effectiveness.

public static CombatForecast Forecast(Unit attacker, Weapon attackWeapon, Unit defender, Weapon? defendWeapon, int attackerTerrainAvoid, int attackerTerrainDefense, int defenderTerrainAvoid, int defenderTerrainDefense, CombatRules? rules = null, IList<string>? attackerSkills = null, IList<string>? defenderSkills = null, int supportHit = 0, int supportAvoid = 0, SeededRng? procRng = null, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, SkillDef>? skillCatalog = null)
Parameter Type Description
attacker Unit The attacking unit supplying stats and HP base.
attackWeapon Weapon The attacking weapon supplying might, hit, crit, and weight.
defender Unit The defending unit supplying defensive stats.
defendWeapon Weapon? The defending weapon for triangle and counter AS, or null when disarmed.
attackerTerrainAvoid int Avoid from the attacker tile (display only).
attackerTerrainDefense int Defense from the attacker tile (display only).
defenderTerrainAvoid int Avoid from the defender tile added to defender avoid.
defenderTerrainDefense int Defense from the defender tile subtracted from damage.
rules CombatRules? Formula tunables, or null for GBA defaults.
attackerSkills IList<string>? Attacker skill ids applied as flat preview mods.
defenderSkills IList<string>? Defender skill ids applied as flat preview mods.
supportHit int Bonded hit bonus added to the attacker forecast.
supportAvoid int Bonded avoid bonus subtracted as extra defender avoid.
procRng SeededRng? Seeded stream for skill proc rolls, or null to preview without procs.
skillCatalog IReadOnlyDictionary<string, SkillDef>? Explicit skill catalog, or null to use global static catalog.

Returns: CombatForecast — A new forecast copy with skill and support mods applied.

CombatResolver.ForecastHeal

Staff heal preview: HealPower plus half Power, clamped to missing HP.

public static int ForecastHeal(Unit healer, Weapon staff)
Parameter Type Description
healer Unit The healing unit supplying Power.
staff Weapon The staff supplying HealPower.

Returns: int — Unclamped heal amount before the MaxHP cap.

CombatResolver.ForecastStaffHit

Staff accuracy at a distance: weapon hit + Skl*2 + Lck/2 - 5 per tile.

public static int ForecastStaffHit(Unit healer, Weapon staff, int distance)
Parameter Type Description
healer Unit The healing unit supplying Skill and Luck.
staff Weapon The staff supplying base hit.
distance int Distance in tiles, costing 5 hit each.

Returns: int — Clamped staff hit rate from 0 to 100.

CombatResolver.ResolveHeal

Apply a staff heal: consumes 1 use, clamps to MaxHP, returns HP restored.

public static int ResolveHeal(Unit healer, InventoryEntry staffEntry, Unit patient)
Parameter Type Description
healer Unit The healing unit supplying Power.
staffEntry InventoryEntry The staff inventory entry losing one use.
patient Unit The unit receiving the heal up to MaxHP.

Returns: int — HP actually restored after clamping.

CombatResolver.ResolveStaff

Staff use with accuracy: consumes 1 use, rolls 1RN vs ForecastStaffHit; heal staves restore on hit, status staves apply StatusEffect/StatusDuration on hit. Returns true on hit. Staves always use 1RN (GBA shape), ignoring CombatRules.HitMode.

public static bool ResolveStaff(Unit healer, InventoryEntry staffEntry, Unit target, int distance, SeededRng rng)
Parameter Type Description
healer Unit The staff user supplying Skill and Luck for accuracy.
staffEntry InventoryEntry The staff inventory entry losing one use per attempt.
target Unit The unit receiving the heal or status on a hit.
distance int Distance in tiles used by the staff accuracy preview.
rng SeededRng Seeded stream consumed for the single 1RN hit roll.

Returns: bool — True when the staff hit and its heal or status applied.

CombatResolver.GenerateScript

Precomputes the ordered strike log without mutating units, consuming RNG for hit and crit rolls.

public static CombatResult GenerateScript(Unit attacker, Weapon attackWeapon, Unit defender, Weapon? defendWeapon, int distance, int attackerTerrainAvoid, int attackerTerrainDefense, int defenderTerrainAvoid, int defenderTerrainDefense, SeededRng rng, CombatRules? rules = null, IList<string>? attackerSkills = null, IList<string>? defenderSkills = null, int supportHit = 0, int supportAvoid = 0, SeededRng? procRng = null, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, SkillDef>? skillCatalog = null)
Parameter Type Description
attacker Unit The attacking unit supplying stats and starting HP.
attackWeapon Weapon The attacking weapon used for every attacker strike.
defender Unit The defending unit supplying stats and starting HP.
defendWeapon Weapon? The defending weapon for the counter, or null when disarmed.
distance int Distance in tiles gating whether the defender counters.
attackerTerrainAvoid int Avoid from the attacker tile for the counter forecast.
attackerTerrainDefense int Defense from the attacker tile for the counter forecast.
defenderTerrainAvoid int Avoid from the defender tile for the attacker forecast.
defenderTerrainDefense int Defense from the defender tile for the attacker forecast.
rng SeededRng Seeded stream consumed for hit and crit rolls.
rules CombatRules? Formula tunables, or null for GBA defaults.
attackerSkills IList<string>? Attacker skill ids, swapped to defense for the counter.
defenderSkills IList<string>? Defender skill ids, swapped to attack for the counter.
supportHit int Bonded hit bonus for the attacker, swapped for the counter.
supportAvoid int Bonded avoid bonus for the defender, swapped for the counter.
procRng SeededRng? Seeded stream for skill proc rolls, or null to preview without procs.
skillCatalog IReadOnlyDictionary<string, SkillDef>? Explicit skill catalog, or null to use global static catalog.

Returns: CombatResult — Strike log plus projected HP left for both sides, units untouched.

CombatResolver.ApplyScript

Writes a generated script HP outcome back to the combatants.

public static void ApplyScript(Unit attacker, Unit defender, CombatResult script)
Parameter Type Description
attacker Unit The attacking unit receiving the attacker HP left.
defender Unit The defending unit receiving the defender HP left.
script CombatResult Script produced by GenerateScript.

supportAvoid int Bonded avoid bonus for the defender, swapped for the counter.
procRng SeededRng? Seeded stream for skill proc rolls, or null to preview without procs.

SkillHook

When a skill modifies a forecast (attack or defense side).

Name Value Description
OnAttack Applies when the skilled unit attacks.
OnDefense Applies when the skilled unit defends.

SkillDef

Flat forecast modifiers for one skill id. Proc skills use ProcChance (0-100, 1RN).

SkillDef.Id

Unique skill id matched against Unit.Skills entries.

public string Id { get; }

Type: string

SkillDef.Hook

Side of the exchange this skill modifies.

public SkillHook Hook { get; set; }

Type: SkillHook

SkillDef.DamageBonus

Flat damage added to forecasts on this hook.

public int DamageBonus { get; set; }

Type: int

SkillDef.HitBonus

Flat hit added to forecasts on this hook.

public int HitBonus { get; set; }

Type: int

SkillDef.CritBonus

Flat crit added to forecasts on this hook.

public int CritBonus { get; set; }

Type: int

SkillDef.DamageTakenPenalty

Flat damage subtracted from incoming forecasts on defense.

public int DamageTakenPenalty { get; set; }

Type: int

SkillDef.ProcChance

Proc chance from 0 to 100 rolled 1RN, where 0 always applies. Values outside 0-100 throw.

public int ProcChance

Type: int

SkillDef constructor

Creates a skill definition with the given id.

public SkillDef(string id)
Parameter Type Description
id string Unique skill id used for registration and lookup.

SkillDef.Clone

Creates an independent copy of this skill definition.

public SkillDef Clone()

Returns: SkillDef — A new definition with the same hook bonuses and proc chance.

SkillCatalog

Hook point for abilities (Adept/Brave/Sol-adjacent flat mods, armor-slayer tags, ...). Hosts register SkillDefs; ApplyToForecast adds attacker OnAttack mods and defender OnDefense mods to a forecast copy. Proc rolls (if any) consume the passed RNG... pass null to preview without procs. Pure apart from optional proc RNG. Global mutable catalog: hosts must snapshot via TryGetAll/SaveSystem and ChapterState.SkillDefs for deterministic saves/replays; do not mutate mid-chapter without snapshotting.

SkillCatalog.Register

Registers a skill definition, replacing any entry with the same id.

public static void Register(SkillDef def)
Parameter Type Description
def SkillDef The skill definition to store by id.

SkillCatalog.Clear

Clears all registered skill definitions.

public static void Clear()

SkillCatalog.TryGet

Looks up a registered skill definition by id.

public static bool TryGet(string id, out SkillDef? def)
Parameter Type Description
id string The skill id to find.
def out SkillDef? The matching definition, or null when unregistered.

Returns: bool — True when a definition was found.

SkillCatalog.TryGetAll

Returns a deep copy of all registered skill definitions for save snapshot.

public static Dictionary<string, SkillDef> TryGetAll()

Returns: Dictionary<string, SkillDef> — Copy of the id to definition map with cloned definitions.

SkillCatalog.Snapshot

Returns a deep snapshot copy for deterministic save hashing.

public static IReadOnlyDictionary<string, SkillDef> Snapshot()

Returns: IReadOnlyDictionary<string, SkillDef> — Read-only view of the catalog copy with cloned definitions.

SkillCatalog.ApplyToForecast

Returns an adjusted forecast copy with attacker and defender skill mods.

public static CombatForecast ApplyToForecast(CombatForecast baseForecast, IEnumerable<string> attackerSkills, IEnumerable<string> defenderSkills, Random.SeededRng? procRng = null)
Parameter Type Description
baseForecast CombatForecast The input forecast, never mutated.
attackerSkills IEnumerable<string> Attacker skill ids applied through the OnAttack hook.
defenderSkills IEnumerable<string> Defender skill ids applied through the OnDefense hook.
procRng Random.SeededRng? Seeded stream for proc rolls, or null to preview without procs.

Returns: CombatForecast — A new forecast with flat damage, hit, and crit mods applied.

public static CombatForecast ApplyToForecast(CombatForecast baseForecast, IEnumerable<string> attackerSkills, IEnumerable<string> defenderSkills, Random.SeededRng? procRng, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, SkillDef>? catalog)
Parameter Type Description
baseForecast CombatForecast The input forecast, never mutated.
attackerSkills IEnumerable<string> Attacker skill ids applied through the OnAttack hook.
defenderSkills IEnumerable<string> Defender skill ids applied through the OnDefense hook.
procRng Random.SeededRng? Seeded stream for proc rolls, or null to preview without procs.
catalog IReadOnlyDictionary<string, SkillDef>? Explicit skill catalog, or null to use the global static catalog.

Returns: CombatForecast — A new forecast with flat damage, hit, and crit mods applied.

WeaponTriangle

Weapon-triangle (sword > axe > lance > sword; anima > light > dark > anima). Bows and staves sit outside the triangle. Bonuses are injectable (GBA: +1 Mt, +15 Hit). Reaver weapons (Weapon.ReversesTriangle) swap advantage for their wielder.

WeaponTriangle.Advantage

Rates triangle advantage: 1 for advantage, -1 for disadvantage, 0 otherwise.

public static int Advantage(WeaponType attacker, WeaponType defender)
Parameter Type Description
attacker WeaponType The attacking weapon type.
defender WeaponType The defending weapon type.

Returns: int — 1 when the attacker wins, -1 when the defender wins, else 0.

public static int Advantage(Weapon attacker, Weapon defender)
Parameter Type Description
attacker Weapon The attacking weapon (ReversesTriangle swaps advantage).
defender Weapon The defending weapon (ReversesTriangle swaps advantage).

Returns: int — 1 when the attacker wins, -1 when the defender wins, else 0, with reaver swap applied.

The defending weapon for attack speed, or null to use the incoming weapon. incomingWeapon Weapon The incoming weapon used for attack speed when disarmed. defenderTerrainAvoid int Avoid from the defender tile. Returns: int — Unclamped avoid total. CombatResolver.ComputeCritRate Crit rate: half skill plus weapon crit minus defender luck. public static int ComputeCritRate(Unit attacker, Weapon attackWeapon, Unit defender) Parameter Type Description attacker Unit The attacking unit supplying skill. attackWeapon Weapon The attacking weapon supplying base crit. defender Unit The defending unit supplying luck. Returns: int — Clamped crit rate from 0 to 100. CombatResolver.ComputeAttackCount Strike count: 2 when the attacker doubles, else 1. public static int ComputeAttackCount(Unit attacker, Weapon attackWeapon, Unit defender, Weapon? defendWeapon, CombatRules? rules = null) Parameter Type Description attacker Unit The attacking unit supplying attack speed. attackWeapon Weapon The attacking weapon supplying weight. defender Unit The defending unit supplying attack speed. defendWeapon Weapon? The defending weapon for speed, or null when disarmed. rules CombatRules? Formula tunables, or null for GBA defaults. Returns: int — Number of attacker strikes, 1 or 2. CombatResolver.Forecast Pure GBA-style forecast: damage, hit, crit, strikes, triangle, effectiveness. public static CombatForecast Forecast(Unit attacker, Weapon attackWeapon, Unit defender, Weapon? defendWeapon, int attackerTerrainAvoid, int attackerTerrainDefense, int defenderTerrainAvoid, int defenderTerrainDefense, CombatRules? rules = null, IList<string>? attackerSkills = null, IList<string>? defenderSkills = null, int supportHit = 0, int supportAvoid = 0, SeededRng? procRng = null, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, SkillDef>? skillCatalog = null) Parameter Type Description attacker Unit The attacking unit supplying stats and HP base. attackWeapon Weapon The attacking weapon supplying might, hit, crit, and weight. defender Unit The defending unit supplying defensive stats. defendWeapon Weapon? The defending weapon for triangle and counter AS, or null when disarmed. attackerTerrainAvoid int Avoid from the attacker tile (display only). attackerTerrainDefense int Defense from the attacker tile (display only). defenderTerrainAvoid int Avoid from the defender tile added to defender avoid. defenderTerrainDefense int Defense from the defender tile subtracted from damage. rules CombatRules? Formula tunables, or null for GBA defaults. attackerSkills IList<string>? Attacker skill ids applied as flat preview mods. defenderSkills IList<string>? Defender skill ids applied as flat preview mods. supportHit int Bonded hit bonus added to the attacker forecast. supportAvoid int Bonded avoid bonus subtracted as extra defender avoid. procRng SeededRng? Seeded stream for skill proc rolls, or null to preview without procs. skillCatalog IReadOnlyDictionary<string, SkillDef>? Explicit skill catalog, or null to use global static catalog. Returns: CombatForecast — A new forecast copy with skill and support mods applied. CombatResolver.ForecastHeal Staff heal preview: HealPower plus half Power, clamped to missing HP. public static int ForecastHeal(Unit healer, Weapon staff) Parameter Type Description healer Unit The healing unit supplying Power. staff Weapon The staff supplying HealPower. Returns: int — Unclamped heal amount before the MaxHP cap. CombatResolver.ForecastStaffHit Staff accuracy at a distance: weapon hit + Skl*2 + Lck/2 - 5 per tile. public static int ForecastStaffHit(Unit healer, Weapon staff, int distance) Parameter Type Description healer Unit The healing unit supplying Skill and Luck. staff Weapon The staff supplying base hit. distance int Distance in tiles, costing 5 hit each. Returns: int — Clamped staff hit rate from 0 to 100. CombatResolver.ResolveHeal Apply a staff heal: consumes 1 use, clamps to MaxHP, returns HP restored. public static int ResolveHeal(Unit healer, InventoryEntry staffEntry, Unit patient) Parameter Type Description healer Unit The healing unit supplying Power. staffEntry InventoryEntry The staff inventory entry losing one use. patient Unit The unit receiving the heal up to MaxHP. Returns: int — HP actually restored after clamping. CombatResolver.ResolveStaff Staff use with accuracy: consumes 1 use, rolls 1RN vs ForecastStaffHit; heal staves restore on hit, status staves apply StatusEffect/StatusDuration on hit. Returns true on hit. Staves always use 1RN (GBA shape), ignoring CombatRules.HitMode. public static bool ResolveStaff(Unit healer, InventoryEntry staffEntry, Unit target, int distance, SeededRng rng) Parameter Type Description healer Unit The staff user supplying Skill and Luck for accuracy. staffEntry InventoryEntry The staff inventory entry losing one use per attempt. target Unit The unit receiving the heal or status on a hit. distance int Distance in tiles used by the staff accuracy preview. rng SeededRng Seeded stream consumed for the single 1RN hit roll. Returns: bool — True when the staff hit and its heal or status applied. CombatResolver.GenerateScript Precomputes the ordered strike log without mutating units, consuming RNG for hit and crit rolls. public static CombatResult GenerateScript(Unit attacker, Weapon attackWeapon, Unit defender, Weapon? defendWeapon, int distance, int attackerTerrainAvoid, int attackerTerrainDefense, int defenderTerrainAvoid, int defenderTerrainDefense, SeededRng rng, CombatRules? rules = null, IList<string>? attackerSkills = null, IList<string>? defenderSkills = null, int supportHit = 0, int supportAvoid = 0, SeededRng? procRng = null, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, SkillDef>? skillCatalog = null) Parameter Type Description attacker Unit The attacking unit supplying stats and starting HP. attackWeapon Weapon The attacking weapon used for every attacker strike. defender Unit The defending unit supplying stats and starting HP. defendWeapon Weapon? The defending weapon for the counter, or null when disarmed. distance int Distance in tiles gating whether the defender counters. attackerTerrainAvoid int Avoid from the attacker tile for the counter forecast. attackerTerrainDefense int Defense from the attacker tile for the counter forecast. defenderTerrainAvoid int Avoid from the defender tile for the attacker forecast. defenderTerrainDefense int Defense from the defender tile for the attacker forecast. rng SeededRng Seeded stream consumed for hit and crit rolls. rules CombatRules? Formula tunables, or null for GBA defaults. attackerSkills IList<string>? Attacker skill ids, swapped to defense for the counter. defenderSkills IList<string>? Defender skill ids, swapped to attack for the counter. supportHit int Bonded hit bonus for the attacker, swapped for the counter. supportAvoid int Bonded avoid bonus for the defender, swapped for the counter. procRng SeededRng? Seeded stream for skill proc rolls, or null to preview without procs. skillCatalog IReadOnlyDictionary<string, SkillDef>? Explicit skill catalog, or null to use global static catalog. Returns: CombatResult — Strike log plus projected HP left for both sides, units untouched. CombatResolver.ApplyScript Writes a generated script HP outcome back to the combatants. public static void ApplyScript(Unit attacker, Unit defender, CombatResult script) Parameter Type Description attacker Unit The attacking unit receiving the attacker HP left. defender Unit The defending unit receiving the defender HP left. script CombatResult Script produced by GenerateScript. CombatResolver.Resolve Pure seeded exchange: attacker strikes then a possible in-range counter, mutating HP. public static CombatResult Resolve(Unit attacker, Weapon attackWeapon, Unit defender, Weapon? defendWeapon, int distance, int attackerTerrainAvoid, int attackerTerrainDefense, int defenderTerrainAvoid, int defenderTerrainDefense, SeededRng rng, CombatRules? rules = null, IList<string>? attackerSkills = null, IList<string>? defenderSkills = null, int supportHit = 0, int supportAvoid = 0, SeededRng? procRng = null, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, SkillDef>? skillCatalog = null) Parameter Type Description attacker Unit The attacking unit whose HP is updated. attackWeapon Weapon The attacking weapon used for every attacker strike. defender Unit The defending unit whose HP is updated. defendWeapon Weapon? The defending weapon for the counter, or null when disarmed. distance int Distance in tiles gating whether the defender counters. attackerTerrainAvoid int Avoid from the attacker tile for the counter forecast. attackerTerrainDefense int Defense from the attacker tile for the counter forecast. defenderTerrainAvoid int Avoid from the defender tile for the attacker forecast. defenderTerrainDefense int Defense from the defender tile for the attacker forecast. rng SeededRng Seeded stream consumed for hit and crit rolls. rules CombatRules? Formula tunables, or null for GBA defaults. attackerSkills IList<string>? Attacker skill ids, swapped to defense for the counter. defenderSkills IList<string>? Defender skill ids, swapped to attack for the counter. supportHit int Bonded hit bonus for the attacker, swapped for the counter. supportAvoid int Bonded avoid bonus for the defender, swapped for the counter. procRng SeededRng? Seeded stream for skill proc rolls, or null to preview without procs. skillCatalog IReadOnlyDictionary<string, SkillDef>? Explicit skill catalog, or null to use global static catalog. Returns: CombatResult — Strike log plus clamped HP left for both sides. public static CombatResult Resolve(Unit attacker, InventoryEntry attackEntry, Unit defender, InventoryEntry? defendEntry, int distance, int attackerTerrainAvoid, int attackerTerrainDefense, int defenderTerrainAvoid, int defenderTerrainDefense, SeededRng rng, CombatRules? rules = null, IList<string>? attackerSkills = null, IList<string>? defenderSkills = null, int supportHit = 0, int supportAvoid = 0, SeededRng? procRng = null, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, SkillDef>? skillCatalog = null) Parameter Type Description attacker Unit The attacking unit whose HP is updated. attackEntry InventoryEntry The attacker inventory entry losing one use per strike attempt. defender Unit The defending unit whose HP is updated. defendEntry InventoryEntry? The defender inventory entry losing one use on its counter, or null. distance int Distance in tiles gating whether the defender counters. attackerTerrainAvoid int Avoid from the attacker tile for the counter forecast. attackerTerrainDefense int Defense from the attacker tile for the counter forecast. defenderTerrainAvoid int Avoid from the defender tile for the attacker forecast. defenderTerrainDefense int Defense from the defender tile for the attacker forecast. rng SeededRng Seeded stream consumed for hit and crit rolls. rules CombatRules? Formula tunables, or null for GBA defaults. attackerSkills IList<string>? Attacker skill ids, swapped to defense for the counter. defenderSkills IList<string>? Defender skill ids, swapped to attack for the counter. supportHit int Bonded hit bonus for the attacker, swapped for the counter. supportAvoid int Bonded avoid bonus for the defender, swapped for the counter. procRng SeededRng? Seeded stream for skill proc rolls, or null to preview without procs. skillCatalog IReadOnlyDictionary<string, SkillDef>? Explicit skill catalog, or null to use global static catalog. Returns: CombatResult — Strike log plus clamped HP left for both sides. SkillHook When a skill modifies a forecast (attack or defense side). Name Value Description OnAttack Applies when the skilled unit attacks. OnDefense Applies when the skilled unit defends. SkillDef Flat forecast modifiers for one skill id. Proc skills use ProcChance (0-100, 1RN). SkillDef.Id Unique skill id matched against Unit.Skills entries. public string Id { get; } Type: string SkillDef.Hook Side of the exchange this skill modifies. public SkillHook Hook { get; set; } Type: SkillHook SkillDef.DamageBonus Flat damage added to forecasts on this hook. public int DamageBonus { get; set; } Type: int SkillDef.HitBonus Flat hit added to forecasts on this hook. public int HitBonus { get; set; } Type: int SkillDef.CritBonus Flat crit added to forecasts on this hook. public int CritBonus { get; set; } Type: int SkillDef.DamageTakenPenalty Flat damage subtracted from incoming forecasts on defense. public int DamageTakenPenalty { get; set; } Type: int SkillDef.ProcChance Proc chance from 0 to 100 rolled 1RN, where 0 always applies. Values outside 0-100 throw. public int ProcChance Type: int SkillDef constructor Creates a skill definition with the given id. public SkillDef(string id) Parameter Type Description id string Unique skill id used for registration and lookup. SkillDef.Clone Creates an independent copy of this skill definition. public SkillDef Clone() Returns: SkillDef — A new definition with the same hook bonuses and proc chance. SkillCatalog Hook point for abilities (Adept/Brave/Sol-adjacent flat mods, armor-slayer tags, ...). Hosts register SkillDefs; ApplyToForecast adds attacker OnAttack mods and defender OnDefense mods to a forecast copy. Proc rolls (if any) consume the passed RNG... pass null to preview without procs. Pure apart from optional proc RNG. Global mutable catalog: hosts must snapshot via TryGetAll/SaveSystem and ChapterState.SkillDefs for deterministic saves/replays; do not mutate mid-chapter without snapshotting. SkillCatalog.Register Registers a skill definition, replacing any entry with the same id. public static void Register(SkillDef def) Parameter Type Description def SkillDef The skill definition to store by id. SkillCatalog.Clear Clears all registered skill definitions. public static void Clear() SkillCatalog.TryGet Looks up a registered skill definition by id. public static bool TryGet(string id, out SkillDef? def) Parameter Type Description id string The skill id to find. def out SkillDef? The matching definition, or null when unregistered. Returns: bool — True when a definition was found. SkillCatalog.TryGetAll Returns a deep copy of all registered skill definitions for save snapshot. public static Dictionary<string, SkillDef> TryGetAll() Returns: Dictionary<string, SkillDef> — Copy of the id to definition map with cloned definitions. SkillCatalog.Snapshot Returns a deep snapshot copy for deterministic save hashing. public static IReadOnlyDictionary<string, SkillDef> Snapshot() Returns: IReadOnlyDictionary<string, SkillDef> — Read-only view of the catalog copy with cloned definitions. SkillCatalog.ApplyToForecast Returns an adjusted forecast copy with attacker and defender skill mods. public static CombatForecast ApplyToForecast(CombatForecast baseForecast, IEnumerable<string> attackerSkills, IEnumerable<string> defenderSkills, Random.SeededRng? procRng = null) Parameter Type Description baseForecast CombatForecast The input forecast, never mutated. attackerSkills IEnumerable<string> Attacker skill ids applied through the OnAttack hook. defenderSkills IEnumerable<string> Defender skill ids applied through the OnDefense hook. procRng Random.SeededRng? Seeded stream for proc rolls, or null to preview without procs. Returns: CombatForecast — A new forecast with flat damage, hit, and crit mods applied. public static CombatForecast ApplyToForecast(CombatForecast baseForecast, IEnumerable<string> attackerSkills, IEnumerable<string> defenderSkills, Random.SeededRng? procRng, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, SkillDef>? catalog) Parameter Type Description baseForecast CombatForecast The input forecast, never mutated. attackerSkills IEnumerable<string> Attacker skill ids applied through the OnAttack hook. defenderSkills IEnumerable<string> Defender skill ids applied through the OnDefense hook. procRng Random.SeededRng? Seeded stream for proc rolls, or null to preview without procs. catalog IReadOnlyDictionary<string, SkillDef>? Explicit skill catalog, or null to use the global static catalog. Returns: CombatForecast — A new forecast with flat damage, hit, and crit mods applied. WeaponTriangle Weapon-triangle (sword > axe > lance > sword; anima > light > dark > anima). Bows and staves sit outside the triangle. Bonuses are injectable (GBA: +1 Mt, +15 Hit). Reaver weapons (Weapon.ReversesTriangle) swap advantage for their wielder. WeaponTriangle.Advantage Rates triangle advantage: 1 for advantage, -1 for disadvantage, 0 otherwise. public static int Advantage(WeaponType attacker, WeaponType defender) Parameter Type Description attacker WeaponType The attacking weapon type. defender WeaponType The defending weapon type. Returns: int — 1 when the attacker wins, -1 when the defender wins, else 0. public static int Advantage(Weapon attacker, Weapon defender) Parameter Type Description attacker Weapon The attacking weapon (ReversesTriangle swaps advantage). defender Weapon The defending weapon (ReversesTriangle swaps advantage). Returns: int — 1 when the attacker wins, -1 when the defender wins, else 0, with reaver swap applied.

title: API: SrpgCore.Data
html:
API: SrpgCore.Data

Generated from ../SrpgCore sources by scripts/build-api.ts — do not edit by hand.

Guide: data.

Deployment

One unit's chapter entry: the Unit snapshot, Position tile it spawns on, SpawnTurn (1 = starting roster), and optional Group id for spawn_group events.

Deployment.Unit

Deployed unit reference.

public Unit Unit { get; }

Type: Unit

Deployment.Position

Board tile the unit spawns on.

public GridPoint Position { get; }

Type: GridPoint

Deployment.SpawnTurn

Round the unit spawns on, 1 for starting roster.

public int SpawnTurn { get; }

Type: int

Deployment.Group

Reinforcement group id for spawn_group-style events, empty when none.

public string Group { get; }

Type: string

Deployment constructor

Binds a unit to a spawn tile, turn, and optional group.

public Deployment(Unit unit, GridPoint position, int spawnTurn = 1, string group =)
Parameter Type Description
unit Unit Unit to deploy.
position GridPoint Board tile the unit spawns on.
spawnTurn int Round the unit spawns on, minimum 1.
group string Reinforcement group id, empty when none.

ObjectiveKind

Victory and defeat objective shapes evaluated by the chapter runtime.

Name Value Description
Rout Win by destroying every live unit of the tagged side.
Survive Win by completing the tagged number of full rounds.
Protect Lose when any listed nid dies after spawning.
Seize Win when a live tagged unit stands on the tagged region.
Escape Win when a live tagged unit stands on the tagged escape region.
EventOnly Never auto-evaluated, win and lose commands decide.

ObjectiveSpec

One victory or defeat rule: Kind selects shape, then Side for Rout, Turns for Survive, Tags for Protect (protected nids) and Seize or Escape (unit nid + region name), and EventOnly for scripted win/lose.

ObjectiveSpec.Kind

Objective shape driving evaluation.

public ObjectiveKind Kind { get; }

Type: ObjectiveKind

ObjectiveSpec.Side

Target side for rout-style checks.

public Affiliation Side { get; set; }

Type: Affiliation

ObjectiveSpec.Turns

Full rounds required for survive objectives.

public int Turns { get; set; }

Type: int

ObjectiveSpec.Tags

Unit nids, region names, or seize pair in unit then region order.

public List<string> Tags { get; }

Type: List<string>

ObjectiveSpec.RoutEnemies

Builds a victory rule destroying every live enemy unit.

public static ObjectiveSpec RoutEnemies()

Returns: ObjectiveSpec — Rout spec targeting the enemy side.

ObjectiveSpec.Survive

Builds a victory rule completing a number of full rounds.

public static ObjectiveSpec Survive(int turns)
Parameter Type Description
turns int Full rounds required, must be at least 1.

Returns: ObjectiveSpec — Survive spec with the tagged turn count.

ObjectiveSpec.Protect

Builds a defeat rule firing when any listed unit nid dies.

public static ObjectiveSpec Protect(params string[] tags)
Parameter Type Description
tags params string[] Protected unit nids matched against deployments and templates.

Returns: ObjectiveSpec — Protect spec carrying the tagged nids.

ObjectiveSpec.Seize

Builds a victory rule for standing a live unit on a region.

public static ObjectiveSpec Seize(string unitNid, string regionName)
Parameter Type Description
unitNid string Nid of the seizing unit.
regionName string Name of the target region.

Returns: ObjectiveSpec — Seize spec carrying unit then region names.

ObjectiveSpec.Escape

Builds a victory rule for escaping a live unit to a region.

public static ObjectiveSpec Escape(string unitNid, string regionName)
Parameter Type Description
unitNid string Nid of the escaping unit.
regionName string Name of the escape region.

Returns: ObjectiveSpec — Escape spec carrying unit then region names.

ObjectiveSpec.AllDead

Builds a defeat rule firing when no live player unit remains.

public static ObjectiveSpec AllDead()

Returns: ObjectiveSpec — Rout spec targeting the player side.

ObjectiveSpec.EventOnly

Builds a rule never auto-evaluated so event commands decide.

public static ObjectiveSpec EventOnly()

Returns: ObjectiveSpec — EventOnly spec for scripted outcomes.

InteractableKind

Map interactable kind: doors/chests open, villages visit.

Name Value Description
Door Openable door tile, optionally locked behind a key item.
Chest Openable chest tile yielding its contents once.
Village Visitable village tile granting its reward once.

Interactable

One tile interactable: a locked/unlocked door or chest (opened via the open verb, locked ones consuming a KeyId inventory item) or a village (visited once via the visit verb). Opened/visited state at runtime lives in ChapterState.Vars ("opened_"/"visited_") so saves round-trip; Opened mirrors the flag for data-side readers.

Interactable.Name

Unique name matched by open and visit event verbs.

public string Name { get; set; }

Type: string

Interactable.Kind

Door, chest, or village behavior.

public InteractableKind Kind { get; set; }

Type: InteractableKind

Interactable.Position

Board tile this interactable sits on.

public GridPoint Position { get; set; }

Type: GridPoint

Interactable.Locked

True when opening consumes a key item.

public bool Locked { get; set; }

Type: bool

Interactable.KeyId

Inventory item id consumed to unlock, empty when keyless.

public string KeyId { get; set; }

Type: string

Interactable.Opened

Mirrors the opened or visited runtime flag for data-side readers.

public bool Opened { get; set; }

Type: bool

Interactable.BecomesTerrainKey

Terrain key the tile becomes after open or visit, empty when none.

public string BecomesTerrainKey { get; set; }

Type: string

Interactable constructor

Places one door, chest, or village on the map.

public Interactable(string name, InteractableKind kind, GridPoint position)
Parameter Type Description
name string Unique name matched by event verbs.
kind InteractableKind Door, chest, or village behavior.
position GridPoint Board tile this interactable sits on.

Chapter

Chapter definition (data side): Nid/Title identity, Board, Deployments, Regions, Events, Victory/Defeat ObjectiveSpecs, Armory weapons by key for give_item, UnitTemplates for spawn_unit, MaxDeploy roster cap (0 = everyone), and NextChapter link. Validate() reports authoring errors for editors to surface; a clean chapter validates to an empty list.

Chapter.Nid

Chapter id linking NextChapter references and save slots.

public string Nid { get; set; }

Type: string

Chapter.Title

Display title for banners and chapter screens.

public string Title { get; set; }

Type: string

Chapter.Board

Playable board, null until the loader assigns one.

public Board? Board { get; set; }

Type: Board?

Chapter.ObjectiveText

Display objective for banners/menus (not evaluated).

public string ObjectiveText { get; set; }

Type: string

Chapter.Deployments

Unit placements with spawn turns and reinforcement groups.

public List<Deployment> Deployments { get; }

Type: List<Deployment>

Chapter.Regions

Named tile rects for events, seize goals, and formation.

public List<Region> Regions { get; }

Type: List<Region>

Chapter.Events

Trigger-driven event scripts with validated verb commands.

public List<GameEvent> Events { get; }

Type: List<GameEvent>

Chapter.Victory

Victory rules, any one completing ends the chapter won.

public List<ObjectiveSpec> Victory { get; }

Type: List<ObjectiveSpec>

Chapter.Defeat

Defeat rules, any one completing ends the chapter lost.

public List<ObjectiveSpec> Defeat { get; }

Type: List<ObjectiveSpec>

Chapter.Armory

Weapons by key for unit items and give_item spawns.

public Dictionary<string, Weapon> Armory { get; }

Type: Dictionary<string, Weapon>

Chapter.UnitTemplates

Unit blueprints by nid for spawn_unit reinforcements.

public Dictionary<string, Unit> UnitTemplates { get; }

Type: Dictionary<string, Unit>

Chapter.Interactables

Doors, chests, and villages placed on the map (see Interactable).

public List<Interactable> Interactables { get; }

Type: List<Interactable>

Chapter.MaxDeploy

0 = deploy everyone; otherwise max player units on turn 1.

public int MaxDeploy { get; set; }

Type: int

Chapter.MaxInventory

Maximum inventory entries per unit, default 5.

public int MaxInventory { get; set; }

Type: int

Chapter.IsIso

Diamond (isometric) presentation when true; flat grid otherwise. Set once per chapter via META view, like Unity's 2D/3D project choice.

public bool IsIso { get; set; }

Type: bool

Chapter.FormationRegion

Name of the formation region limiting deployment tiles.

public string FormationRegion { get; set; }

Type: string

Chapter.NextChapter

Nid of the following chapter, empty when this chapter ends the chain.

public string NextChapter { get; set; }

Type: string

Chapter.Validate

Reports authoring errors for editors to surface, empty when clean.

public List<string> Validate()

Returns: List<string> — One message per off-board tile, duplicate name, bad verb, or dangling tag.

WeaponType

Weapon damage triangle and magic families plus staves.

Name Value Description
Sword 0 Beats axes, loses to lances in the GBA triangle.
Lance 1 Beats swords, loses to axes in the GBA triangle.
Axe 2 Beats lances, loses to swords in the GBA triangle.
Bow 3 Ranged physical weapon, never participates in triangle bonus.
Anima 4 Fire, thunder, and wind tomes.
Light 5 Light magic tomes.
Dark 6 Dark magic tomes.
Staff 7 Healing and status staves, targets allies.

WeaponRank

Weapon rank letter gating who can equip a weapon, E lowest through S highest.

Name Value Description
E 0 Entry rank, always reachable at zero wexp.
D 1 Unlocked at 20 wexp.
C 2 Unlocked at 50 wexp.
B 3 Unlocked at 80 wexp.
A 4 Unlocked at 120 wexp.
S 5 Top rank, unlocked at 180 wexp.

Affiliation

Which army a unit fights for. Values: Player (player-controlled), Enemy (hostile), Ally (NPC own phase), Other (neutral, fights nobody).

Name Value Description
Player 0 Player-controlled units.
Enemy 1 Hostile units acting on the enemy phase.
Ally 2 NPC ally with its own phase, never player-controlled.
Other 3 Neutral third party fighting nobody.

ChapterParseError

One loader complaint with file + 1-based line (0 = chapter-level).

ChapterParseError.File

Source file name the complaint came from.

public string File { get; }

Type: string

ChapterParseError.Line

One-based line number, 0 for chapter-level problems.

public int Line { get; }

Type: int

ChapterParseError.Message

Human-readable complaint for editors to surface.

public string Message { get; }

Type: string

ChapterParseError constructor

Records one loader complaint with file and line.

public ChapterParseError(string file, int line, string message)
Parameter Type Description
file string Source file name.
line int One-based line number, 0 for chapter-level problems.
message string Human-readable complaint.

ChapterParseError.ToString

Renders file, line, and message as one log line.

public override string ToString()

Returns: string — Single-line file and line complaint string.

ChapterParseResult

Outcome of one markdown load: a chapter on success plus every complaint.

ChapterParseResult.Chapter

Parsed chapter, null when any error was collected.

public Chapter? Chapter { get; set; }

Type: Chapter?

ChapterParseResult.Errors

Every file and line complaint, empty on a clean load.

public List<ChapterParseError> Errors { get; }

Type: List<ChapterParseError>

ChapterParseResult.Ok

True when a chapter parsed with zero errors.

public bool Ok => Errors.Count == 0 && Chapter != null;

Type: bool

MarkdownChapterLoader

Markdown chapter format: one file per chapter with META / LEGEND / MAP / ARMORY / TEMPLATES / UNITS / TERRAINS / REGIONS / INTERACTABLES / EVENTS sections mapping 1:1 onto Chapter. Collects every error with file + line instead of throwing on the first, so editors can surface them all. Full spec: SRPGDocs chapter-format page. Current format: 1.

MarkdownChapterLoader.CurrentFormat

Markdown format version this loader reads, required as format 1 in META.

public const int CurrentFormat = 1;

Type: int

MarkdownChapterLoader.Load

Parses one markdown chapter file using the standard terrain set.

public static ChapterParseResult Load(string text, string fileName)
Parameter Type Description
text string Full markdown file contents.
fileName string File name stamped onto every error.

Returns: ChapterParseResult — Result carrying the chapter on success or every complaint on failure.

public static ChapterParseResult Load(string text, string fileName, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, TerrainType> baseTerrains)
Parameter Type Description
text string Full markdown file contents.
fileName string File name stamped onto every error.
baseTerrains IReadOnlyDictionary<string, TerrainType> Base terrain entries extended by TERRAINS rows.

Returns: ChapterParseResult — Result carrying the chapter on success or every complaint on failure.

ClassDatabase

Minimal class database: keyed UnitClass entries for promotion and movement lookup. Hosts own the data (markdown, JSON, editor DB); the core only resolves keys.

ClassDatabase.Add

Registers one class entry keyed by its Key, replacing any same-key entry.

public void Add(UnitClass cls)
Parameter Type Description
cls UnitClass Class entry to store.

ClassDatabase.TryGet

Looks up one class entry by key ignoring case.

public bool TryGet(string key, out UnitClass? cls)
Parameter Type Description
key string Class key to resolve.
cls out UnitClass? Found entry, null when absent.

Returns: bool — True when the key resolves to an entry.

ClassDatabase.Get

Resolves one class entry by key, failing fast on unknown keys.

public UnitClass Get(string key)
Parameter Type Description
key string Class key to resolve.

Returns: UnitClass — The matching class entry.

Promotion

Promotion: rekey ClassKey, adopt the new class movement, apply fixed gains. GBA per-class gains are host data; callers pass them as a Stats delta.

Promotion.CanPromote

Tests whether a unit class chain offers a resolvable promotion target.

public static bool CanPromote(Unit unit, ClassDatabase db)
Parameter Type Description
unit Unit Unit whose ClassKey starts the lookup.
db ClassDatabase Class database resolving both ends of the chain.

Returns: bool — True when the current class promotes to a known class.

Promotion.Apply

Promotes a unit to a new class, adopting its movement and stat gains.

WeaponRanks

Weapon experience (GBA-flavored fork): each combat use banks points per weapon type on the wielder; rank letters gate equipping (a unit needs the letter rank for the weapon it holds). Thresholds are data here, not scattered constants. Fork thresholds are E 0, D 20, C 50, B 80, A 120, S 180; GBA FE7/8 uses 0, 31, 71, 121, 181, 251 (S at 251). Wexp is capped at 255 (byte max) to match GBA and prevent overflow. Deterministic: pure functions over ints, no RNG.

ObjectiveKind Victory and defeat objective shapes evaluated by the chapter runtime. Name Value Description Rout Win by destroying every live unit of the tagged side. ClassDatabase.TryGet Looks up one class entry by key ignoring case. public bool TryGet(string key, out UnitClass? cls) Parameter Type Description key string Class key to resolve. cls out UnitClass? Found entry, null when absent. Returns: bool — True when the key resolves to an entry. ClassDatabase.Get Resolves one class entry by key, failing fast on unknown keys. public UnitClass Get(string key) Parameter Type Description key string Class key to resolve. Returns: UnitClass — The matching class entry. Promotion Promotion: rekey ClassKey, adopt the new class movement, apply fixed gains. GBA per-class gains are host data; callers pass them as a Stats delta. Promotion.CanPromote Tests whether a unit class chain offers a resolvable promotion target. public static bool CanPromote(Unit unit, ClassDatabase db) Parameter Type Description unit Unit Unit whose ClassKey starts the lookup. db ClassDatabase Class database resolving both ends of the chain. Returns: bool — True when the current class promotes to a known class. Promotion.Apply Promotes a unit to a new class, adopting its movement and stat gains. public static void Apply(Unit unit, string newClassKey, ClassDatabase db, Stats? gains = null) Parameter Type Description unit Unit Unit to rekey and mutate in place. newClassKey string Target class key resolved through the database. db ClassDatabase Class database resolving the target entry. gains Stats? Host-supplied per-class stat delta, null for none. StandardTerrains Starter terrain set with GBA-flavored defaults. Hosts can replace the set with their own data; gameplay code must only depend on TerrainType. MoveCost -1 (const Impassable) blocks that move type. StandardTerrains.Impassable Move cost blocking a movement group from entering a tile. public const int Impassable = -1; Type: int StandardTerrains.Create Builds the GBA-flavored starter terrain set keyed by terrain id. public static Dictionary<string, TerrainType> Create() Returns: Dictionary<string, TerrainType> — Fresh dictionary of plain, road, forest, fort, and blocking tiles. Stats GBA-style stat block: MaxHP, Power (Str or Mag — the weapon's IsMagic flag selects Def vs Res on the target), Skill (hit, crit), Speed (attack speed, relieved by Constitution against weapon weight), Luck (hit, avoid, crit dodge), Defense, Resistance, Constitution (carry capacity and attack-speed relief). Level-ups roll each stat against GrowthRates; promotion adds fixed gains passed by the caller. Stats.MaxHP Maximum hit points, also the spawn value for CurrentHP. public int MaxHP { get; set; } Type: int Stats.Power Strength or magic power, selected by the weapon used. public int Power { get; set; } Type: int Stats.Skill Accuracy and crit-rate driver for GBA combat math. public int Skill { get; set; } Type: int Stats.Speed Attack speed driver and GBA doubling threshold stat. public int Speed { get; set; } Type: int Stats.Luck Luck driver for hit, avoid, and crit evade. public int Luck { get; set; } Type: int Stats.Defense Physical damage reduction against non-magic weapons. public int Defense { get; set; } Type: int Stats.Resistance Magical damage reduction against magic weapons. public int Resistance { get; set; } Type: int Stats.Constitution Weight relief against weapon slowdown for attack speed. public int Constitution { get; set; } Type: int Stats.Clone Copies every stat field into a fresh block. public Stats Clone() Returns: Stats — A new Stats with identical field values. Statuses Status effects (poison/sleep/silence/...): name -> turns remaining on Unit.Statuses. Pure helpers; hosts tick at phase boundaries and gate actions (sleep/silence) themselves. Statuses.Apply Applies a named status for a positive duration, refreshing any existing entry. public static void Apply(Unit unit, string name, int duration) Parameter Type Description unit Unit Unit whose Statuses map to mutate. name string Status name, trimmed and lowercased. duration int Turns remaining, must be at least 1. Statuses.Has Tests whether a live status entry remains on the unit. public static bool Has(Unit unit, string name) Parameter Type Description unit Unit Unit whose Statuses map to read. name string Status name, trimmed and lowercased. Returns: bool — True when the entry exists with turns remaining above zero. Statuses.IsSilenced True when unit is silenced (blocks magic and staff). public static bool IsSilenced(Unit unit) Parameter Type Description unit Unit Unit to test. Returns: bool — True when silenced. Statuses.Clear Removes one status entry regardless of remaining duration. public static bool Clear(Unit unit, string name) Parameter Type Description unit Unit Unit whose Statuses map to mutate. name string Status name, trimmed and lowercased. Returns: bool — True when an entry was present and removed. Statuses.Tick Decrement all durations by 1; expired entries are removed. Returns expired names in sorted order. public static List<string> Tick(Unit unit) Parameter Type Description unit Unit Unit whose Statuses map to tick. Returns: List<string> — Names that reached zero and were removed. TerrainEffects Per-round terrain HP swing (fort heal, poison/marsh damage). Pure: returns the applied delta and mutates CurrentHP, clamped to [0, MaxHP]. Callers decide timing (once per round per team, at phase boundaries — not per activation). Nonzero percents always move at least 1 HP (ceiling rounding). TerrainEffects.Apply Applies terrain HP swing to one unit, clamped at zero. public static int Apply(Unit unit, TerrainType terrain) Parameter Type Description unit Unit The unit standing on the tile (mutates CurrentHP). terrain TerrainType The tile terrain definition carrying HpEffectPercent. Returns: int — Signed HP delta applied, zero when no effect or the unit is dead. InventoryEntry A weapon carried by a unit, with remaining durability (UsesLeft starts at MaxUses; IsBroken at zero, and broken entries cannot strike). InventoryEntry.Weapon Shared weapon definition for this carried item. public Weapon Weapon { get; } Type: Weapon InventoryEntry.UsesLeft Remaining durability, decremented per strike attempt. public int UsesLeft { get; set; } Type: int InventoryEntry constructor Carries one weapon with remaining durability defaulting to full. public InventoryEntry(Weapon weapon, int? usesLeft = null) Parameter Type Description weapon Weapon Shared weapon definition to carry. usesLeft int? Remaining uses, defaults to the weapon maximum. InventoryEntry.IsBroken True when no durability remains. public bool IsBroken => UsesLeft <= 0; Type: bool Unit Battlefield unit: identity (Nid, Name, Side, ClassKey), growth state (Level, Experience toward 100 per level, Stats), live HP (CurrentHP, IsAlive while above zero), movement (MovePoints, MovementGroup), Vision fog radius, and collections: Inventory entries with durability, Skill ids, Statuses (name to turns left), Wexp per weapon type, CarryingNid ("" when hands-free). The constructor takes nid, name, side, class key, and stats (HP starts at MaxHP, Level at 1); Clone re-keys copies for reinforcements, staging, and saves. Unit.Nid Unique id used by events, conditions, and spawn references. public string Nid { get; } Type: string Unit.Name Display name for dialogue and menus. public string Name { get; set; } Type: string Unit.Side Which army this unit fights for. public Affiliation Side { get; set; } Type: Affiliation Unit.ClassKey Class database key, rekeyed by promotion. public string ClassKey { get; set; } Type: string Unit.SpriteKey Per-unit art override key into the host pack sprite library ("" = class art). Display-only data like Name: rules never read it; hosts resolve it. public string SpriteKey { get; set; } Type: string Unit.Level Current level driving experience gain math. public int Level { get; set; } Type: int Unit.Experience Accumulated experience toward the next level at 100. public int Experience { get; set; } Type: int Unit.Stats Live stat block mutated by level-ups and promotion gains. public Stats Stats { get; set; } Type: Stats Unit.CurrentHP Current hit points, dead at zero. public int CurrentHP { get; set; } Type: int Unit.MovePoints Personal movement allowance in tiles (default 5). Promotion adopts the new class move; Rescue halves it while laden. public int MovePoints { get; set; } Type: int Unit.MovementGroup Movement group key into terrain costs (default infantry). public string MovementGroup { get; set; } Type: string Unit.Vision Fog sight radius in Manhattan tiles (default 5, GBA-ish). public int Vision { get; set; } Type: int Unit.Skills Skill ids on this unit (see Combat.SkillCatalog for effects). public List<string> Skills { get; } Type: List<string> Unit.Statuses Active status effects: name -> turns remaining (poison/sleep/silence/...). public Dictionary<string, int> Statuses { get; } Type: Dictionary<string, int> Unit.CarryingNid Nid of the rescued passenger being carried ("" = none). public string CarryingNid { get; set; } Type: string Unit.AiType AI behavior type for enemy units (rush, hold, patrol). public string AiType { get; set; } Type: string Unit.PatrolA Patrol waypoint A for patrol AI (ignored otherwise). public Grid.GridPoint PatrolA { get; set; } Type: Grid.GridPoint Unit.PatrolB Patrol waypoint B for patrol AI (ignored otherwise). public Grid.GridPoint PatrolB { get; set; } Type: Grid.GridPoint Unit.Wexp Weapon experience per type (see Data.WeaponRanks for thresholds). public Dictionary<WeaponType, int> Wexp { get; } Type: Dictionary<WeaponType, int> Unit.Inventory Carried weapons with per-entry durability. public IList<InventoryEntry> Inventory => _inventory; Type: IList<InventoryEntry> Unit.IsAlive True while CurrentHP is above zero. public bool IsAlive => CurrentHP > 0; Type: bool Unit.Clone Copy for reinforcements/staging; optionally re-keyed (nids must stay unique on a map). public Unit Clone(string? newNid = null) Parameter Type Description newNid string? Replacement nid, defaults to keeping the source nid. Returns: Unit — A deep copy with matching stats, inventory, wexp, skills, and statuses. Unit constructor Creates a unit at full health from a stat block. public Unit(string nid, string name, Affiliation side, string classKey, Stats stats) Parameter Type Description nid string Unique id used by events and conditions. name string Display name for dialogue and menus. side Affiliation Which army this unit fights for. classKey string Class database key. stats Stats Stat block the unit shares by reference until cloned. UnitClass Class definition (database entry). Values: Key id, Name, MoveType family for terrain costs, Move base points, and optional PromotesTo target key. UnitClass.Key Database key used by Unit.ClassKey and chapter class fields. public string Key { get; } Type: string UnitClass.Name Display name for menus and promotion screens. public string Name { get; } Type: string UnitClass.MoveType Movement family resolving terrain costs via MovementGroups. public MoveType MoveType { get; } Type: MoveType UnitClass.Move Base movement points adopted on promotion. public int Move { get; } Type: int UnitClass.PromotesTo Promotion target class key, null when this class cannot promote. public string? PromotesTo { get; } Type: string? UnitClass constructor Defines one class database entry with movement and promotion target. public UnitClass(string key, string name, MoveType moveType, int move, string? promotesTo = null) Parameter Type Description key string Database key other data references. name string Display name for menus. moveType MoveType Movement family for terrain costs. move int Base movement points. promotesTo string? Promotion target class key, null for no promotion. Weapon Weapon definition (database entry): Key, Name, Type, Rank (E-S gate via WeaponRanks), combat numbers (Might, Hit, Crit, Weight, MinRange/MaxRange in Manhattan tiles, MaxUses durability), and flags: IsMagic (targets Res), EffectiveAgainst class keys, HealPower and StatusEffect/StatusDuration for staves. Instances with durability live on Unit as InventoryEntry values; InRange tests a distance, IsStaff and IsEffectiveAgainst read the flags. Weapon.Key Database key referenced by chapter armory and unit items lists. public string Key { get; } Type: string Weapon.Name Display name for menus and inventory screens. public string Name { get; } Type: string Weapon.Type Damage family driving triangle bonus and magic selection. public WeaponType Type { get; } Type: WeaponType Weapon.Rank Minimum rank letter required to equip this weapon. public WeaponRank Rank { get; } Type: WeaponRank Weapon.Might Base damage added before triangle and effectiveness bonuses. public int Might { get; } Type: int Weapon.Hit Base accuracy before skill, luck, and terrain avoid. public int Hit { get; } Type: int Weapon.Crit Base critical rate before skill bonus. public int Crit { get; } Type: int Weapon.Weight Heft slowing attack speed after constitution relief. public int Weight { get; } Type: int Weapon.MinRange Minimum Manhattan attack distance. public int MinRange { get; } Type: int Weapon.MaxRange Maximum Manhattan attack distance. public int MaxRange { get; } Type: int Weapon.MaxUses Full durability for fresh inventory entries. public int MaxUses { get; } Type: int Weapon.IsMagic True when damage targets resistance instead of defense. public bool IsMagic { get; } Type: bool Weapon.CanCounter True when this weapon can be used to counterattack (default true; set false for long-range siege or pacifist staves). public bool CanCounter { get; set; } Type: bool Weapon.EffectiveAgainst Class keys or tags this weapon is effective against (armor, flier, ...). Empty = none. public List<string> EffectiveAgainst { get; } Type: List<string> Weapon.HealPower Staff heal power (>0 = healing staff, uses Might-style base). 0 = damaging weapon. public int HealPower { get; set; } Type: int Weapon.StatusEffect Status staff effect name (sleep/silence/...) applied on hit. "" = none. public string StatusEffect { get; set; } Type: string Weapon.StatusDuration Duration in turns for StatusEffect. public int StatusDuration { get; set; } Type: int Weapon.CanSteal True when this weapon can be stolen (light items; heavy/legendary set false). public bool CanSteal { get; set; } Type: bool Weapon.ReversesTriangle True when this weapon reverses weapon-triangle advantage (reaver weapons, default false). public bool ReversesTriangle { get; set; } Type: bool Weapon.Price Shop price in gold. 0 = not for sale (spawn pool only). public int Price { get; set; } Type: int Weapon.IsStaff True for staff type or any healing or status payload (legacy broad check). public bool IsStaff => Type == WeaponType.Staff || HealPower > 0 || StatusEffect.Length > 0; Type: bool Weapon.IsHealStaff True when HealPower is positive (healing staff payload). public bool IsHealStaff => HealPower > 0; Type: bool Weapon.IsStatusStaff True when StatusEffect is set (status staff payload). public bool IsStatusStaff => StatusEffect.Length > 0; Type: bool Weapon constructor Defines one weapon database entry with combat and durability stats. public Weapon(string key, string name, WeaponType type, WeaponRank rank, int might, int hit, int crit, int weight, int minRange, int maxRange, int maxUses, bool isMagic = false) Parameter Type Description key string Database key referenced by armory rows. name string Display name for menus. type WeaponType Damage family driving triangle and magic selection. rank WeaponRank Minimum rank letter required to equip. might int Base damage. hit int Base accuracy. crit int Base critical rate. weight int Heft slowing attack speed. minRange int Minimum Manhattan attack distance. maxRange int Maximum Manhattan attack distance. maxUses int Full durability for fresh entries. isMagic bool True when damage targets resistance. Weapon.InRange Tests whether a Manhattan distance falls inside the weapon range. public bool InRange(int distance) Parameter Type Description distance int Manhattan distance between attacker and target. Returns: bool — True when distance sits between MinRange and MaxRange inclusive. Weapon.CanCounterAt Tests whether this weapon can counterattack at a distance. public bool CanCounterAt(int distance) Parameter Type Description distance int Manhattan distance of the exchange. Returns: bool — True when countering is enabled and distance is in range. Weapon.IsEffectiveAgainst Tests effectiveness bonus against a defender class key. public bool IsEffectiveAgainst(string? defenderClassKey) Parameter Type Description defenderClassKey string? Defender class key or tag, null never matches. Returns: bool — True when the key matches an EffectiveAgainst entry ignoring case. WeaponRanks Weapon experience (GBA-flavored fork): each combat use banks points per weapon type on the wielder; rank letters gate equipping (a unit needs the letter rank for the weapon it holds). Thresholds are data here, not scattered constants. Fork thresholds are E 0, D 20, C 50, B 80, A 120, S 180; GBA FE7/8 uses 0, 31, 71, 121, 181, 251 (S at 251). Wexp is capped at 255 (byte max) to match GBA and prevent overflow. Deterministic: pure functions over ints, no RNG. WeaponRanks.PointsForRank Reads the wexp floor required for a rank letter. public static int PointsForRank(WeaponRank rank) Parameter Type Description rank WeaponRank Rank letter to look up. Returns: int — Wexp points needed to reach a rank (E 0, D 20, C 50, B 80, A 120, S 180). WeaponRanks.RankFor Reads the highest rank letter unlocked by a wexp total. public static WeaponRank RankFor(int points) Parameter Type Description points int Banked wexp total, negatives read as E. Returns: WeaponRank — Highest rank whose threshold points meet or beat (negatives read as E). WeaponRanks.CanEquip Tests whether a wexp total unlocks a required rank. public static bool CanEquip(int points, WeaponRank required) Parameter Type Description points int Banked wexp total. required WeaponRank Rank letter the weapon demands. Returns: bool — True when points meet the required rank's threshold. WeaponRanks.PointsOf Current wexp for a type on a unit (0 when never used). public static int PointsOf(Unit unit, WeaponType type) Parameter Type Description unit Unit Unit whose Wexp map to read. type WeaponType Weapon family to look up. Returns: int — Banked points for the type, or zero. WeaponRanks.AddWexp Banks wexp on the unit, capped at 255 (GBA byte max); returns the new total for the type. public static int AddWexp(Unit unit, WeaponType type, int points) Parameter Type Description unit Unit Unit whose Wexp map to mutate. type WeaponType Weapon family to credit. points int Nonnegative points to add. Returns: int — New total for the type after banking, clamped to 255.

title: API: SrpgCore.Events
html:
API: SrpgCore.Events

Generated from ../SrpgCore sources by scripts/build-api.ts — do not edit by hand.

Guide: events.

EventCommand

One event command: verb;arg0;arg1;.... Verbs are validated against CommandCatalog; the engine (Prowl or other) implements them in IEventExecutor.

EventCommand.Verb

Gets the verb name validated against CommandCatalog.

public string Verb { get; }

Type: string

EventCommand.Args

Gets the trimmed arguments following the verb in source order.

public string[] Args { get; }

Type: string[]

EventCommand constructor

Initializes a command with a verb and its argument list.

public EventCommand(string verb, string[] args)
Parameter Type Description
verb string The command verb such as speak or move_unit.
args string[] The argument values in source order.

EventCommand.Parse

Parses one semicolon separated line into a verb plus trimmed arguments.

public static EventCommand Parse(string line)
Parameter Type Description
line string The source line shaped verb plus semicolon separated args.

Returns: EventCommand — The parsed command with verb and argument values.

EventCommand.ToString

Formats the command back to its semicolon separated source shape.

public override string ToString()

Returns: string — The verb followed by its semicolon separated arguments.

CommandCatalog

Known verbs with exact arity. The editor uses this for validation/autocomplete; the runner rejects unknown verbs before executing anything.

CommandCatalog.TryValidate

Checks that the verb is known and the argument count fits its catalog arity.

public static bool TryValidate(EventCommand command, out string? error)
Parameter Type Description
command EventCommand The command to validate without executing anything.
error out string? The reason the command was rejected or null when it is valid.

Returns: bool — True when the verb is known and the arity matches.

CommandCatalog.List

Enumerates every known verb with its one line authoring help.

public static IEnumerable<(string verb, string help)> List()

Returns: IEnumerable<(string verb, string help)> — Each catalog verb paired with its help text.

EventDispatcher

Multi-event dispatch: all events subscribed to a trigger run in priority order (then name — deterministic; duplicates all run).

EventDispatcher.Dispatch

Runs every event subscribed to a trigger in priority then name order and stops at the first error.

public static List<EventRunResult> Dispatch(EventTrigger trigger, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object?> vars, IEnumerable<GameEvent> events, IEventExecutor executor)
Parameter Type Description
trigger EventTrigger The raised trigger selecting which events run.
vars IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object?> Trigger variables visible to the condition language.
events IEnumerable<GameEvent> The candidate events of which only trigger matches run.
executor IEventExecutor Host that executes each validated command.

Returns: List<EventRunResult> — One result per attempted event in dispatch order.

IEventExecutor

Implemented by the host engine (Prowl presentation layer, tests, future ports). The core validates and orders commands; only the executor touches the outside world.

EventRunResult

Outcome of one EventRunner run including validation failures.

EventRunResult.Ran

Gets or sets whether the condition passed and the commands ran.

public bool Ran { get; set; }

Type: bool

EventRunResult.CommandsExecuted

Gets or sets how many commands the executor ran in order.

public int CommandsExecuted { get; set; }

Type: int

EventRunResult.Error

Gets or sets the condition or validation failure or null on success.

public string? Error { get; set; }

Type: string?

EventRunner

Runs one event: checks the condition against trigger vars, validates every command up front (fail before side effects), then dispatches in order. Trigger dispatch across many events belongs to the future TurnManager, not here.

EventRunner.Run

Runs one event when its condition passes; validates all commands before any side effect.

public static EventRunResult Run(GameEvent gameEvent, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object?> vars, IEventExecutor executor)
Parameter Type Description
gameEvent GameEvent The event definition (trigger already matched by the caller).
vars IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object?> Trigger variables visible to the condition language.
executor IEventExecutor Host that executes each validated command.

Returns: EventRunResult — Whether the event ran, commands executed, and any validation error.

EventTrigger

Engine-raised triggers. The TurnManager/battle code raises these; GameEvents subscribe to them.

Name Value Description
LevelStart 0 Fires when the chapter opens.
LevelEnd 1 Fires when the chapter closes.
PlayerPhaseStart 2 Fires at each player phase boundary.
EnemyPhaseStart 3 Fires at each enemy phase boundary.
UnitDeath 4 Fires when a unit dies with unit nid and position available.
UnitWait 5 Fires when a unit waits with unit nid and position available.
UnitSelect 6 Fires when a unit is selected with unit nid and position available.
UnitLevelUp 7 Fires when a unit levels up with unit nid available.
CombatStart 8 Fires when combat starts with attacker, defender, item, and position available.
CombatEnd 9 Fires when combat ends with attacker, defender, item, and position available.
Talk 10 Fires when two units talk with both units and position available.
Support 11 Fires when a support grows with both units and rank available.
RegionEntered 12 Fires when a unit enters a region with unit, region, and position available.

GameEvent

Scripted event: unique name + trigger + condition expression + command list. Conditions evaluate against trigger variables (see SimpleConditionEvaluator).

GameEvent.Name

Gets the unique author facing event name.

public string Name { get; }

Type: string

GameEvent.Trigger

Gets the trigger this event subscribes to.

public EventTrigger Trigger { get; }

Type: EventTrigger

GameEvent.Condition

Gets the gating expression where empty means always run.

public string Condition { get; }

Type: string

GameEvent.Priority

Dispatch order among same-trigger events (LT default 20; higher runs first).

public int Priority { get; set; }

Type: int

GameEvent.Commands

Gets the ordered command list dispatched when the event runs.

public IList<EventCommand> Commands => _commands;

Type: IList<EventCommand>

GameEvent constructor

Initializes an event with a name, trigger, and optional gating condition.

public GameEvent(string name, EventTrigger trigger, string condition =)
Parameter Type Description
name string The unique author facing event name.
trigger EventTrigger The trigger this event subscribes to.
condition string The gating expression where empty means always run.

GameEvent.AddCommand

Parses one command line and appends it to the ordered command list.

public void AddCommand(string line)
Parameter Type Description
line string The source line shaped verb plus semicolon separated args.

SimpleConditionEvaluator

Minimal condition language for event gating: unit.nid == 'Eirika' && turn > 3 Clauses joined by &&; each is path op literal with ops ==, !=, >, <, >=, <=. Paths resolve against nested string/object dictionaries (e.g. vars["unit"]["nid"]). Literals: 'quoted', numbers, true/false. Unknown paths evaluate to null (== null-safe false). Deliberately tiny: replace with a real scripting bridge only if chapters outgrow it.

SimpleConditionEvaluator.Evaluate

Evaluates a condition against trigger vars where empty always passes and clauses join with AND.

public static bool Evaluate(string condition, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object?> vars)
Parameter Type Description
condition string The clauses joined by AND with each shaped path op literal.
vars IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object?> The nested trigger variables that dotted paths resolve against.

Returns: bool — True when every clause passes or the condition is empty.

Paths resolve against nested string/object dictionaries (e.g. vars["unit"]["nid"]). Literals: 'quoted', numbers, true/false. Unknown paths evaluate to null (== null-safe false). Deliberately tiny: replace with a real scripting bridge only if chapters outgrow it. SimpleConditionEvaluator.Evaluate Evaluates a condition against trigger vars where empty always passes and clauses join with AND. public static bool Evaluate(string condition, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object?> vars) Parameter Type Description condition string The clauses joined by AND with each shaped path op literal. vars IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object?> The nested trigger variables that dotted paths resolve against. Returns: bool — True when every clause passes or the condition is empty.
